Messages.Author: islandofyiaros
Messages.Body:
Some abilities that Vidal Jarbeaux can use are also part of another one or require another one. For example, you can't be a Prince without being Camarilla; you can't be a Seraph without being Black Hand.

The question is: Can he play a card requiring Sabbat, then later play a card requiring a Cardinal--or does playing a Cardinal card imply he's using his "play a Sabbat card once per game" as well?

Thanks in advance.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> islandofyiaros wrote:
> you can't be a Prince without being Camarilla;
>
True.

> islandofyiaros wrote:
> you can't be a Seraph without being Black Hand.
>
Untrue. "Black Hand" and "Seraph" are just meaningless card text. Nothing in the rules does anything to them. The Black Hand set introduced no new rules.  [LSJ 20030711]

> islandofyiaros wrote:
> Can he play a card requiring Sabbat, then later play a card requiring a Cardinal--or does playing a Cardinal card imply he's using his "play a Sabbat card once per game" as well?
>
It depends on card text.

If a card says: "Requires a {title}" then Vidal sees that as him meeting the title for the purposes of his special - the fact that the sect comes along with it isn't relevant for his special. If a card said "Requires a {sect} and a {title}" or similar (e.g. several cards say "Requires a titled Sabbat vampire"), then the explicit requirement would be noticed by his special.

[LSJ 20081124]

> LSJ wrote:
> >>> 1/ If Vidal uses his cardtext to play a card that requires a Baron,
> >>> would that count against the Anarch trait also ?
>
> >> Not for his special.
>
> > The card "sees" him as an Anarch Baron, but he did not met the Anarch
> > requirement. This is kinda strange to me.
>
> "Requires a Baron". He met that requirement.
>

Messages.Author: gatocion

Another question regarding Vidal's hability.

If he plays an Ankara Citadel and it gets DI, is it still able to fake Tremere?

Thanks!

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> gatocion wrote:
> Another question regarding Vidal's hability.
> If he plays an Ankara Citadel and it gets DI, is it still able to fake Tremere?
>
Ankara Citadel was played, even if it was cancelled as played, which means that Vidal has used his ability (otherwise the card couldn't have been played).

(This is different from cost reduction vs DI, or locking Enkil Cog vs DI).
